chaining: No free lane fits this provider: the cheapest start is USD 19 a month on Starter with USD 30 of included usage. Free network traffic still matters for the egress topic, because the same workload on bunny.net would pay USD 0.01 per GB in Europe.

limits.value: 4 vCPU, 32 GiB and 120 GiB per box on every plan

limits_note: the included allowance resets each cycle, so the meter is the plan and not a signup grant; a stopped box keeps billing disk until deletion
binding_note: The shape ceiling is 4 vCPU, but the deciding wall is the rate: USD 0.0504 per vCPU-hour and USD 0.0144 per GiB-hour put the smallest box at USD 48.62 a month.

identity_cost.detail: A prepaid wallet funds usage and paid top-ups are refundable within 14 days; the card type, hold and debit terms were not stated on the page read. Unverified.

reliability_note: Files survive a stop and a start; no reliability event observed.
